purpose: Collects and submits user input as a single named unit with declarative validation and a single primary submit action.

variants.name: stepped
variants.usage: One step of a multi-step flow; shows progress and offers a way back.

props.name: id
props.description: Submit target id referenced by submit actions.

props.name: children
props.description: Fields and content; must contain at least one Field.

props.name: submitLabel
props.description: Label of the generated primary submit button; must state the action (not 'Submit').

props.name: error
props.description: Form-level error summary, announced via role=alert.

accessibility.requirement: The form is introduced by a heading describing the task.
On failed submit, an error summary receives focus and links to offending fields.
Stepped forms announce 'Step X of Y' as text, not just visually.

constraints.rule: A form contains at least one Field.
submitLabel states the action ('Create account'), never a generic 'Submit'.
Exactly one primary submit action per form.
